text:
nina: Brainstorm: runbook + controller for a session-aware canary that uses probabilistic sampling per-tenant and a Bayesian anomaly detector for auto-fallback. Want to avoid noisy-tenant flips. Thoughts?

arjun: Love it. Key pieces: sample_rate per-tenant, session-stickiness, and an anomaly score that aggregates latency + model-quality. Bayesian detector helps reduce false positives.

paul: Implementation note: session-stickiness means we must tag sessions with `x-session-hash` and ensure router respects affinity when variant is live. Also expose `sample_rate` on rollout config.

anya: For the detector I propose: maintain running priors per-tenant baseline (mu, sigma) and compute posterior probability that current window differs. If prob > alpha -> trigger soft quarantine. Alpha default 0.999.

nina: Nice. Can we fit this into a rollout schema? Prefer minimal knobs for teams.

arjun: Sketch: ```yaml
rollout_id: r-3391
sampling:
  mode: tenant-proportional  # tenant-proportional | fixed | adaptive
  default_rate: 0.01
  max_rate: 0.1
affinity:
  session_cookie: X-SESSION
  stickiness_window_sec: 3600
detector:
  type: bayesian
  alpha: 0.999
  window_sec: 60
policy:
  action_on_alarm: quarantine|evacuate
  quarantine_window_sec: 120
  require_manual_confirm: false
telemetry_tag: x-rollout-sample
```

paul: Two edge cases: 1) Tenant with low traffic -> detector has high uncertainty. Use a min_samples threshold before trusting detector. 2) Burst traffic -> use adaptive sampling that increases sample_rate slowly, not jump.

anya: Agree. Add `min_samples` and `ramp_rate` config. Also recommend we emit `detector.prob` metric for transparency.

nina: Ownership? arjun handles router affinity + sampling header, paul owns detector lib and per-tenant priors, anya will prototype detector algorithm and tests. I'll update the runbook.

arjun: Router action API: `POST /rollouts/:id/actions` with payload {action: "quarantine", reason: "detector:prob>alpha", tenant: "t-123"}. Router will apply `drain_mode: allow_inflight` by default.

paul: For evacuate we should add a staged fallback: first reduce new sessions for that tenant by 90%, then full evacuate if persists. Config: `staged_evict_steps: [90, 100]`.

rollout-bot: detector-job-77 started for r-3391 (initiated by anya)

nina: Good progress. Action items: arjun add affinity + sampling header, paul add min_samples + staged_evict, anya push detector prototype + dashboard panel showing per-tenant posterior. We'll demo next week.
